notes: Only the trtllm-serve surface is modelled. With backend=trt the decisive settings are baked into the engine at build time and never appear as serve flags — put them in args anyway and describe the build in provenance.notes, otherwise the run is not reproducible.

params.name: model
params.help: Hugging Face id, local checkpoint or prebuilt engine directory. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: backend
params.help: Runtime backend. The PyTorch flow needs no separate engine build; trt uses a compiled engine.

params.name: ep-size
params.help: Expert parallel size for MoE models.

params.name: max-batch-size
params.help: Maximum batch size baked into the engine.

params.name: max-seq-len
params.help: Maximum sequence length; defaults to the model's own.

params.name: kv-cache-free-gpu-memory-fraction
params.help: Fraction of free device memory given to the KV cache.

params.name: trust-remote-code
params.help: Execute modelling code from the weights repo.

params.name: extra-llm-api-options
params.help: YAML file with everything the CLI does not expose. Dropped from the fingerprint, so summarise its contents in provenance.notes.

params.name: host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.
